source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — national institution/services registry
why_relevant: Canonical institution directory with official names, hierarchy and web addresses — the backbone for building and maintaining the actor map of state contracting authorities in this cell.

source_name: KZK 'Линкови' page — institutional link directory
why_relevant: Curated list of peer regulators and international competition networks maintained by the authority itself. Cheap snowball surface for further oversight actors and for regional comparators.

source_name: Institutional mirror pages of contracting authorities (ministries, municipalities, funds) — e.g. Министерство за одбрана, Министерство за дигитална трансформација, Општина Кратово
why_relevant: Many договорни органи republish their own notices, annual procurement plans (годишен план за јавни набавки) and concluded contracts on their own sites — sometimes with attachments and plan-level forward-looking detail that the ESJN record lacks. The annual plans are the earliest signal of an upcoming banking/payments/POS purchase, months before a notice appears.

source_name: CompanyWall / ABV.mk — company registry aggregators (КИБС АД Скопје)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregators of Central Registry data: legal identity, ownership, financials and addresses for KIBS, CDHV and their suppliers. Used to resolve aliases and to size the counterparties.

source_name: НБРСМ — Листа на водечки броеви на банките (bank leading numbers)
why_relevant: Canonical bank identifier list (payment-system leading numbers) — ideal join key for reconciling bank names across association lists, tender notices and registry records.

source_name: ЗЕЛС — Заедница на единиците на локалната самоуправа
why_relevant: Umbrella body of all MK municipalities; runs a unit supporting municipal electronic services and software, and co-organises with УЈП the rollout of е-фактура to municipalities and ЈКП. It is the best single pointer to the full municipal actor list and to sector-wide digitisation programmes that precede local tenders.

source_name: МАСИТ — Членки на МАСИТ (ICT chamber member directory)
why_relevant: Paginated directory of Macedonian ICT companies with names and websites; the primary way to enumerate the long tail of local IT vendors/integrators that bid on bank and public payments tenders (KIBS AD Skopje is a listed member).

source_name: МАСИТ - Комора за информатичка и комуникациска технологија (годишна конференција + именик на членки)
why_relevant: The MK ICT chamber's annual conference (20th edition, 'MASIT 2.0 Recode Reality', 300+ participants) publishes sponsor/patron lists, and its member directory is the actor map of MK IT vendors and integrators - the supply side that bids on bank tenders. Sponsorship of a chamber event by a payments vendor is a market-entry tell.

source_name: MASIT — Macedonian ICT Chamber member directory
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map for MK IT suppliers. Member profiles (ASEE Group, CaSys International, and others) give the candidate vendor universe from which customer-reference and press pages can be harvested — the seed list for the whole cell.

source_name: MASIT — ICT Chamber of Commerce member directory & news
why_relevant: 100+ member ICT companies with individual member profile pages — the canonical actor map for MK integrators; news section covers digitalisation initiatives touching payments/fiscalisation.

source_name: Македонска банкарска асоцијација (МБА) — Членови
why_relevant: Enumerates the full banking-sector membership (14 banks, savings houses, KIBS clearing house, Macedonian Credit Bureau) — the canonical actor list of contracting authorities on the demand side for banking/payments tenders.

source_name: Macedonian Banking Association (MBA) — member list
why_relevant: Canonical buyer-side actor list. Needed to build the keyword set (official names, MK Cyrillic forms, transliterations) that vendor press releases must be filtered against; without it, vendor-feed monitoring misses renamed or merged banks.

source_name: Влада на РСМ — Јавни набавки (централна страница)
why_relevant: Government-level procurement page and ministry directory; useful for enumerating contracting authorities and finding each ministry's procurement subpage, including MDT's.

source_name: Влада на РСМ — Јавни набавки / Отворена влада section
why_relevant: Government-level index of procurement transparency commitments and per-government-body procurement links; useful for enumerating the population of contracting authorities (договорни органи) to monitor, and for tracking policy changes to publication obligations.

entity_name: Агенција за заштита на правото на слободен пристап до информациите од јавен карактер
source_name: Агенција за заштита на правото на слободен пристап до информациите од јавен карактер (ASPI) — FOI route
why_relevant: Maintains the register of information holders (иматели на информации) with their FOI officers' contacts. Provides the legal fallback for obtaining contract texts, bidder lists or e-Pazar data that the ESJN does not publish, and confirms which body to address for each authority.

entity_name: Агенција за заштита на правото на слободен пристап до информациите од јавен карактер
source_name: ASPI — Agency for Protection of the Right to Free Access to Public Information (register of information holders)
why_relevant: Authoritative register of every public-information holder with its FOI officer contacts — the legal route to obtain procurement documents that these authorities do not publish (draft specs, contract annexes, price lists).

entity_name: Агенција за заштита на правото на слободен пристап до информациите од јавен карактер
source_name: Агенција за заштита на правото на слободен пристап до информациите од јавен карактер (АСПИ) — holders-of-information directory
why_relevant: Registry of every 'holder of public information' with its FOI officers and contact details, including ДКЖЈН (entry 30116) and ДКСК (entry 30119). This is the operational key to legally obtaining appeal decisions, audit working papers and case documents that are not proactively published — and АСПИ's own appeal decisions reveal when institutions refuse.

source_name: AmCham North Macedonia — member directory
why_relevant: Second independent vendor register that captures international suppliers operating locally (Asseco SEE, International Card Systems/CaSys listed). Useful to cross-fill gaps in MASIT and to obtain local legal entity names used in contract records.

source_name: OCP Data Registry — North Macedonia: OpenTender publication record
why_relevant: Registry entry describing the MK open-contracting dataset: what is published, in what format (OCDS JSON/Excel/CSV), the source portal it derives from, and coverage/quality caveats. The canonical starting point for locating and validating any machine-readable MK procurement dataset, and a pointer to further publications.

source_name: Zk.mk (Златна книга / business directory)
why_relevant: MK business directory with per-company pages (Некстсенс, Sorsix) and category listings — helps enumerate smaller integrators, POS/ATM service firms and security companies not in MASIT.

source_name: slobodenpristap.mk — FOI request platform (public bodies index)
why_relevant: Indexes MK public bodies and past freedom-of-information requests/answers — the route to obtain registers (e.g. supplier or negative-reference lists) that are not published in machine-readable form.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија — Финансии / Здружение на финансиски организации
why_relevant: The main national chamber hosts an association of financial organisations and a member base; its finance section names partner banks and financial-sector members, providing another cross-check actor list.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија - Здружение за информатичка технологија
why_relevant: The national chamber's IT association organises sector events, B2B meetings and working groups where banks state technology intentions publicly. Chamber event announcements and member lists are a second, independent actor-map and event-calendar source alongside MASIT.

source_name: Civica Mobilitas grantee directory (civicamobilitas.mk)
why_relevant: Donor programme directory of Macedonian civil-society organisations with per-organisation profile pages (CGK and Transparency International – Macedonia both appear). Useful purely as an actor-map expander: it enumerates funded CSOs, their thematic focus and contact/web details, which is how you find the smaller local procurement watchdogs that never rank in search.

source_name: Club200.mk — top-200 MK company profiles
why_relevant: Ranking/profile site for the largest MK companies; sizes integrators (revenue, employees) so supplier tiers can be ranked before deeper tracking.

source_name: ProCredit Holding AG — corporate procurement policy and group disclosures
why_relevant: Pointer to the Frankfurt-based parent of ProCredit Bank AD Skopje and to the group's Corporate Procurement Policy principles (transparency, equality, cost-effectiveness, responsibility; 'value for money' supplier selection) that govern MK-level buying. Use it to reach the authoritative holding-company estate and its annual/impact reports.

source_name: Thales CPL partner directory (Nextsense DOO entry)
why_relevant: Global-vendor partner directories are a reliable, structured way to identify which MK local firms are authorised channel partners for HSM/card/identity technology used by banks.

source_name: Thebanks.eu - профили на банки во Северна Македонија (actor map)
why_relevant: Aggregated list and profiles of MK banks; useful as the seed list for building the per-bank careers/news watchlist that this cell depends on. Not a signal source itself, purely a pointer/actor-map utility (authoritative list should still be taken from NBRM).

source_name: Биznisregulativa.mk — profile of MASIT (chamber registry entry)
why_relevant: Government-run registry of chambers/associations; useful to enumerate ALL sectoral chambers (not just MASIT) that carry member lists relevant to banking, payments and ICT supply.

entity_name: Платформа на граѓански организации за борба против корупцијата
source_name: Платформа на граѓански организации за борба против корупцијата (antikorupcija.mk)
why_relevant: Umbrella platform networking MK civil-society organisations on anti-corruption, with an explicit member directory and an archive of positions/reactions. Public procurement is named as a priority area. Primarily valuable as an actor-map pointer: the members list enumerates the CSOs worth tracking individually for procurement monitoring.
